archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: TACTICAL PRECISION (Clean Light Theme)

entry_surfaces./: split cashier terminal — filterable product & IMEI catalog left (8 cols), active order cart and real-time total panel right (4 cols)
entry_surfaces./products: inventory control center — serialized phone/IMEI units table and quantity accessory tracker with action header
entry_surfaces./transactions: audit log — searchable receipt ledger with transaction status, payment pill, and instant reprint slideover
entry_surfaces./reports: financial summary — daily turnover KPI tiles, sales trend chart, and QRIS vs Cash distribution

layout_and_navigation.theme: Light & Clean (Terang & Bersih) with high contrast borders and crisp data density

grid_modes.pos_screen: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 h-[calc(100vh-4.5rem)]
grid_modes.pos_catalog: col-span-1 lg:col-span-7 xl:col-span-8 flex flex-col h-full bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden
grid_modes.pos_cart: col-span-1 lg:col-span-5 xl:col-span-4 flex flex-col h-full bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden

1_pos_checkout.search_and_filter: Instant search by product name, barcode, or specific IMEI number. Category pills: 'Semua', 'Handphone (IMEI)', 'Aksesoris & Casing', 'Charger & Kabel', 'Audio / TWS', 'Voucher & Pulsa'.
1_pos_checkout.serialized_imei_modal: When adding a Handphone, a dialog prompts to select the specific physical unit (IMEI, Color, Storage Capacity, Condition: Baru/Segel) from in-stock units. Prevents accidental duplicate IMEI sales.
1_pos_checkout.cart_functionality: Cart items show IMEI pill for phones, quantity stepper (+ / -) for accessories, subtotal, and customer name/phone field (for warranty).

checkout_modal.cash_workflow: Preset quick-cash buttons (Uang Pas, 50.000, 100.000, 200.000, 500.000, 1.000.000, 2.000.000), real-time calculation of 'Kembalian' (Change), validation that paid amount >= total.
checkout_modal.qris_workflow: Dynamic QRIS barcode generator preview with NMID / Merchant Name, payment status simulate check, 1-click 'Simulasi QRIS Berhasil'.
checkout_modal.digital_receipt: Receipt popup preview with store header, cashier name, date/time, customer info, itemized list with IMEI numbers, payment method, change, warranty terms ('Garansi Resmi / Toko 7 Hari'), and 'Cetak Struk (Print)' action using window.print() styling.

product_types.description: Serialized tracking. Each unit has unique IMEI (15 digits), Color (e.g. Midnight Black, Titanium Silver), Storage (e.g. 128GB, 256GB, 512GB), RAM, Status (Tersedia, Terjual, Retur).
Bulk quantity tracking (Stok minimum, Satuan pcs, Kategori aksesoris).

2_product_and_stock_management.actions: Tambah Produk Baru, Tambah Stok IMEI Unit Handphone, Edit Harga Jual & Modal, Hapus/Arsipkan, Filter Stok Menipis (<5 pcs).

3_transaction_history.features: Filter tanggal (Hari Ini, 7 Hari Terakhir, Bulan Ini, Kustom), Filter Metode Pembayaran (Tunai / QRIS), Search No. Struk / Nama Pembeli / IMEI, Modal Detail Transaksi lengkap, Cetak Ulang Struk (Reprint Receipt).

visualizations: Grafik Tren Penjualan Harian/Mingguan (Recharts Area/Bar Chart)
Proporsi Metode Pembayaran (Tunai vs QRIS Recharts Pie Chart)
Top 5 Produk Terlaris (Tabel ranking dengan revenue share)

motion_and_interactions.toast_notifications: Sonner toasts on bottom-right for 'Produk ditambahkan ke keranjang', 'Transaksi Berhasil Disimpan', 'Stok Unit IMEI Berhasil Ditambahkan'

accessibility_and_contrast.wcag_compliance: All text tokens provide at least 4.5:1 contrast against their defined surface background.
accessibility_and_contrast.numeric_inputs: Large font-mono numbers for amount inputs with auto-formatted thousands separators (titik pemisah ribuan).
accessibility_and_contrast.keyboard_shortcuts_support: Enter to confirm payment, Esc to close dialogs, F2 for quick search focus.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Light and Clean aesthetic (Terang & Bersih) as requested: use crisp white panels (#FFFFFF), soft slate background (#F8FAFC), subtle borders (#E2E8F0), and vivid brand accent (#0284C7).
Do NOT use dark gradients or heavy dark mode for POS main surfaces. Keep surfaces bright and highly legible for cashier speed.
All copy must be in natural, professional Bahasa Indonesia (e.g. Kasir, Keranjang, Bayar, Tunai, Kembalian, Struk Pembayaran, Stok Tersedia, No. IMEI, Garansi).
Prices must be formatted using Indonesian Rupiah format (e.g., Rp 3.499.000).

Ensure the digital receipt looks authentic: include Store Name ('KASIRKU CELL & ACCESSORIES'), Store Address & WhatsApp number, Cashier Name, Date/Time, Itemized lines with IMEI info, Subtotal, Payment details, and a clean dotted separator with a Print button that invokes window.print() or a cleanly styled printable view.
Ensure Handphone items strictly enforce serial number (IMEI) selection when adding to cart, while Accessories allow standard quantity +/- increments.

Include rich seed data: popular phone models (iPhone 15 Pro, Samsung Galaxy S24, Xiaomi Redmi Note 13, Oppo Reno 11) with realistic 15-digit IMEIs, and popular accessories (Anker 20W Fast Charger, Spigen Case, TWS Earphone, Tempered Glass, Sandisk MicroSD 128GB).
Include pre-installed recharts for daily sales bar/line charts and payment breakdown donut chart on the Laporan Penjualan page.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive and key elements as listed in required_data_testids.
